title: Add autonomous external case discovery and matched-family research intake to the existing Memes v3 workstream
objective: Extend the existing Memes v3 / Alpha Lab research workstream with a bounded discovery intake that can surface unusual historical and prospective cases from approved public sources, deduplicate them, verify exact identity/provenance, estimate research value-of-information, and route only useful cases into the existing launch-replay and empirical-hardening pipelines. Prefer matched failures and counterexamples over retrospective winner accumulation. Do not create a parallel scanner, independent scheduler, trading path, portfolio authority or automatic promotion system.

scope: define a deterministic discovery-lead schema with lead_id, discovered_at, source provenance, source class, candidate chain/identity hints, reason-for-interest, uncertainty and state
implement lifecycle states DISCOVERED_UNVERIFIED -> IDENTITY_VERIFIED -> SOURCE_PROVENANCE_VERIFIED -> REPLAY_CANDIDATE -> MATCHED_FAMILY_BOUND -> OUTCOME_BOUND -> ADJUDICATED
deduplicate by exact chain+CA/mint when known and by source/narrative fingerprints when identity is unresolved
preserve rejected leads and reason codes as research negatives rather than deleting them
forbid any promotion when exact identity or as-of chronology is unresolved
add value-of-information triage that prefers leads adding a new mechanism, matched failure, copycat, same-narrative sibling or unresolved source conflict
route verified high-value leads into the existing launch-replay / empirical-hardening packet format rather than a new engine
support primary-source discovery classes including chain evidence, GitHub/public artifacts, launchpad docs, scientific publications, project sites, explorers/scanners and reputable reporting
bind public_at/observed_at/available_at/computed_at separately and preserve NOT_PROVEN_AS_OF where historical availability cannot be demonstrated
require matched-family construction before adjudicating candidate features from a famous winner

test PRE_LAUNCH_ARTIFACT_PROVENANCE, ARTIFACT_TO_TOKEN_LEAD_TIME, ARTIFACT_EXECUTABILITY, SHIPPING_VELOCITY, NARRATIVE_TRUTH_DENSITY, AGENCY_DECOMPOSITION, NARRATIVE_EMBODIMENT_SPEED, SEMANTIC_QUOTE_ASSET_FIT, CREATOR_ECONOMIC_LOOP_INTENSITY, OPEN_SOURCE_FORKABILITY, COPYCAT_DILUTION_PRESSURE and SCANNER_LEAD_TIME
evaluate whether family-level features discriminate winners from failures prospectively or in timestamp-faithful historical replay
keep every proposed feature in Shadow until matched failures and forward outcomes exist

initial_seed_expectation.rule: All non-FLYBRAIN entries remain DISCOVERED_UNVERIFIED until reconstructed from primary evidence. Names in the seed are not factual validation.

positive: A social or web hit enters as DISCOVERED_UNVERIFIED and cannot be treated as evidence until exact identity and provenance are verified.
A historical winner can be selected for replay without allowing later outcome information to populate earlier feature fields.
A lead with no provable historical public availability records NOT_PROVEN_AS_OF rather than inferred availability.
The system preserves rejected leads with explicit reason codes and can use them as candidate negatives.
High-value discovery triage prefers matched failures/copycats or novel mechanisms over duplicate winner stories.
Verified cases reuse the existing immutable Memes v3 research/replay contracts instead of creating a parallel case engine.
The FLYBRAIN-family seed can be loaded from the private lead registry without exposing private research state publicly.
negative: No GitHub repo, scientific story, AI-agent claim, KOL mention, scanner badge or unusual token pairing independently emits BUY, SELL, size or QUALIFIED_ALPHA.
No later ATH, market cap or survival outcome rewrites an earlier discovery state.
No new scheduler, duplicate scanner, portfolio path or automatic execution path is introduced.
No paid data source or API budget increase is authorized.
No automatic merge or canonical promotion is authorized.
